content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am using the following equipment: [product_name] [article_no], [product_name] [article_no]. Both devices are connected via ethernet cable, but communication isn't fully established—the LED either blinks orange or remains orange. When I manually run a program on the controller, I observe inputs and outputs changing on the operator device and I can activate outputs using the buttons. Data appears to be sent and received over ethernet, yet the connection is not stable (LED doesn’t turn steady green). Device IP configurations are: controller - IP: 192.168.0.203, Subnet: 255.255.255.255.0, Gateway: 192.168.0.1; operator device - IP: 192.168.0.112, Subnet: 255.255.255.0, Gateway: 192.168.0.0.0. I pinged both devices from my computer and the pings succeeded. I haven’t tried loading a program using [product_name] [product_name] V8.3 yet.
For these devices: [product_name] [article_no] and [product_name] [article_no], it’s required to use [product_name] software version V8.3.x.
Hi, To ensure proper communication with your equipment, you indeed need [product_name] version V8.3.
Check out this discussion for download links to the current [product_name] software and firmware. There you will find a link to download [product_name] V8.3.

Hello, I updated to [product_name] V8.3 and now everything works well. Thank you for sharing the link. I'm new to [product_name] and wonder why I can't start or stop my program from the operator device—the option isn't available. See attached image. Regards, [user_name]

It appears you've used the [product_name] in a more basic mode. You've switched the controller to operator mode, which restricts available menus and disables the ability to switch to RUN or STOP. To access full features, enter the “Setup” menu, select it, then choose “Admin mode” and confirm. You’ll be prompted for a password to enable Admin mode. You can set this with the cursor keys. If unchanged, the default is [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues with Ethernet connectivity between a [product_name] module and an operator device, as shown by unclear LED signals. Initial troubleshooting highlighted the importance of using the correct software version ([product_name] V8.3). After updating the software, communication became reliable and most functions operated normally; however, some users were unsure about how to activate program-run features from the operator device, which was linked to device operation modes instead of technical faults.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable Ethernet communication between the controller and operator device, recognizable by LED status, as well as complete access to runtime controls including the ability to start and stop programs directly from the operator interface.
